scenarios.name: returns-all-artifacts-and-enchantments-from-all-graveyards
scenarios.why: 'Return all artifact and enchantment cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under their owners' control': the Sol Ring in seat 0's graveyard returns under seat 0 and the Ghostly Prison in seat 1's returns under seat 1.

scenarios.name: aura-with-nothing-to-enchant-stays-in-the-graveyard
scenarios.why: An Aura card returning this way that has nothing legal to enchant remains in its graveyard, so Rancor stays there; the non-Aura Sol Ring returns.
